question: Will the IOM Missing Migrants Project record at least 1,000 Mediterranean migrant deaths in 2026 before May 2026?
summary: Ensemble aggregate was very high at 95%, driven by recent pace and historical baselines.
Adversarial objections describe credible headwinds (seasonal improvements, enhanced SAR, early-year spike variability) that could dampen the pace.
Threshold analysis shows reaching 1,000 by end-April is plausible but not guaranteed; it requires a sustained high pace into March–April.
Net effect: slightly downward calibration from 0.95 to 0.88 to reflect the plausible reductions while preserving a high-probability assessment.

justification.critique_assessment: Objections are valid and indicate real, non-pathological headwinds that meaningfully reduce the upper bound of the probability; threshold-pace constraints render the outcome plausible but not guaranteed.
justification.adjustment: Adjusted downward from 0.95 to 0.88 to account for credible headwinds and the need to sustain high monthly mortality into March–April; did not adjust for physically implausible scenarios.
